test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No Improvement'.**

She is __as good__ if not better than her sister.
solution:
The correct answer is **as good as**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When in the same sentence two adjectives in different degrees of comparison are used, both should be complete in themselves.
 
• The phrase "**not better than**" may mean "**worse**" or "**almost the same**."
 
 
• **Example: **Divya is **as good as **if not better than her brother. 
 
 
 
• We use **as + adjective/adverb + as** to make comparisons when the things we are comparing are equal in some way:
 
 
• For Example - The world’s biggest bull is **as big as** a small elephant.
 
 
 
• **'As good' **should be replaced by '**as good as'**.
 
• Thus, the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence is **option 2**.

**Correct Sentence:**__ *She is __**as good as**__ if not better than her sister.*
